name: 鲁坎
method: Built-in imagegen substantive redraw, one draft and one corrective revision. Selected v2 containment uses aspect-preserving full-raw NEAREST fit within 72x98 (actual 72x97), centered at (1,1) on 74x100. Alpha threshold 128; no-dither MEDIANCUT; 31 visible colors. Raw side margins below one logical pixel do not prove missing hair. No content restored or repainted. This is a derivative, not native pixel authorship.
color_budget_note: At most 32 visible RGB colors is a temporary working ceiling, not proof of native pixel art.

derivation.quantization: Pillow MAXCOVERAGE from opaque sampled RGB, 32 colors, no dithering
Pillow MEDIANCUT from opaque sampled RGB, 32 colors, no dithering

derivation.quantization: Pillow MEDIANCUT from opaque sampled RGB, 32 colors, no dithering
derivation.centering: integer floor offset; any odd spare pixel remains on bottom/right
derivation.limitation: Raw opaque alpha>=128 does not touch the outermost columns, but its side margins are less than one target logical pixel and NN sampling makes the 74x100 version touch the border. Whole silhouette completeness is not independently proven. Containment adds a transparent margin only; no content is painted or restored.
